title: ED Medical Director — Diversion Request

transcript.speaker: ED Medical Director
transcript.text: AOC, it's Dr. Elaine Whitfield in the ED. I have 27 patients in the department, no lab results since 05:20, and no access to allergy histories or prior ECGs. Two ambulances are en route, and I cannot safely assess a third without lab or imaging data. I'm requesting diversion for ambulance traffic until lab and imaging reports resume.

transcript.speaker: AOC
transcript.text: Understood, Dr. Whitfield. I'm reviewing the status with the CNO and ISO. Diversion is authorized under Section 2 of the Patient Surge and Evacuation Annex, given that a critical system—EHR, lab, and imaging—is down. I will confirm with Lucas County EMS and the regional healthcare coalition.

transcript.speaker: ED Medical Director
transcript.text: Thank you. I'll continue accepting trauma activations and patients in extremis. I'll keep you updated on the ED census.

instructorNote: This inject triggers the diversion decision per EOP 4.3 and ORRMC-SE-ANX-2026. Watch for the AOC to confirm the request, notify external partners, and schedule the two-hour review.
